action_sequence: Deterministic bounded multi-sine commands: port=0.55*sin(0.013*k)+0.25*cos(0.031*k), starboard=0.50*sin(0.017*k+0.4)-0.20*cos(0.029*k), clipped to [-1,1]. Equivalent topology-native excitation must be frozen before a coupled6 tensor run.

acceptance.rule: Every component at every one of 2400 steps must satisfy its absolute tolerance for every initial condition. No tolerance may be changed after measurement. Missing plant support is not a pass.

negative_control: Perturb thruster_tau_s from 0.25 to 0.251 in the candidate; the same comparison must fail before real results are accepted.
